snippets.description: library_items: uuid PK, title/category not null, level/description null, tags text[] default '{}', attachment_id not null UNIQUE FK attachments restrict, created_by FK users, status text default 'published', timestamps
lesson_library_items: composite PK (lesson_id, library_item_id), lesson_id FK lessons cascade, library_item_id FK library_items restrict, attached_by FK users, index on library_item_id; no id column
Additive SQL only: 2 CREATE TABLE, 5 ALTER TABLE ... ADD CONSTRAINT (FKs on the new tables), 1 CREATE INDEX; no DROP, no ALTER COLUMN, no change to existing tables

canAccessAttachment library block between the request-evidence block and the plan block: creator; manager published or linked to a team teacher's lesson; teacher/student linked to own lesson with status <> 'cancelled'. Returns true on a match and otherwise falls through; never returns false

POST /library: requireRole admin/manager; strict zod; attachment exists (404), uploader-or-admin (403), not request evidence (422 ATTACHMENT_NOT_ELIGIBLE), not already an item (409 pre-check + 23505 mapping); name/type/size never taken from the client; insert + library.created in one transaction
PATCH /library/:id: creator-or-admin; strict body without attachmentId/createdBy; empty body 400; library.archived when status flips to archived, else library.updated, same transaction
loadOwnedLesson: lesson exists (404); non-admin must pass managerOwnsTeacher(actor, lesson.teacherId) (403)

POST /lessons/:id/library-items: item published (422 ITEM_ARCHIVED), lesson scheduled/live (422 LESSON_NOT_ATTACHABLE), onConflictDoNothing().returning(); lesson.libraryAttached only when a row was inserted
DELETE /lessons/:id/library-items/:libraryItemId: same ownership, unknown item 404, any lesson status, 204 idempotent, lesson.libraryDetached only when a row was deleted

Bootstrap: manager sees published + own + archived items linked to team lessons and links for team lessons; teacher/student see only links on own non-cancelled lessons and those items; createdBy/attachedBy added to referencedUserIds for managers only; every visible item's attachmentId ships in attachments

library.manage = admin|manager; library.edit = admin or creator manager; lesson.attachLibraryItem = admin or manager where managerIdForTeacher(lesson.teacherId) === actor.id; nothing for teacher/student
Dual-branch services: API branch calls api/library.ts; local branch mirrors the backend rules with assertCan and identical activity action names
